correctness.rationale: Ji–Ma Fact 2.2 shows each high-level induced branch maps affinely across exactly one branch family at levels i≥j−1, with lengths proportional to λ^i; normalized conditional Lebesgue thus gives iid geometric increments G−1. At λ=1/2, from height 1 the first-passage PGF satisfies U=z/(2−U), hence U=1−sqrt(1−z), giving the Catalan mass and central-binomial survival. The zero-mean skip-free walk stopped at 0 or first height h has finite mean stopping time; conditional geometric overshoot above h has mean 1, so optional stopping yields P(H≥h)=1/(h+1). The original-map roof S_{j−1} grows between fixed positive multiples of phi^j; c phi^H≤R≤C τ phi^H. With H windows (1±η)log T/log phi and induced τ survival O(n^{-1/2}), a two-sided probability sandwich gives log(T)P(R>T)->log phi and divergence of every positive moment. Distinguishes induced-block stopping time from actual earliest original-map first hit.
residual_risks: Induced stopping at first level four, not necessarily first original-map visit within a block; starts normalized Lebesgue on a single high-level branch at λ=1/2 only.

Earlier Resultary return law treats the auxiliary Tλ map and three/four-cell return bases, not this level-five starting branch with Fibonacci roof; the later space-time comparison explicitly states its auxiliary map is not semiconjugate to the original induced system. Catalan and geometric-height ingredients are classical, but translating to the physical Fibonacci clock produces a distinct new asymptotic statement not covered by the published induced clock results.
